parameters.query:
SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(x) ORDER BY x.gasto DESC),'[]'::json) AS orcamento
FROM (
  SELECT o.item, o.emoji, o.teto,
         COALESCE((SELECT SUM(l.valor) FROM financas_lancamentos l
           WHERE l.classe='despesa' AND l.status_pluggy='POSTED'
             AND l.data_lancamento >= DATE_TRUNC('month',(now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date)
             AND l.data_lancamento < DATE_TRUNC('month',(now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date) + INTERVAL '1 month'
             AND l.categoria = ANY(o.categorias)),0) AS gasto
  FROM financas_orcamento o WHERE o.ativo = true
) x;
